What's Changed

Exciting New Features 🎉

  • feat(oauth2): add client credentials flow with opt-in config flag by @matzegebbe in #4583
  • feat(connector): connectors for grants by @nabokihms in #4619
  • feat(client): add allowed connectors field to client configuration by @nabokihms in #4610
  • feat(cel): implement CEL compiler with library by @nabokihms in #4607
  • DEP: Auth Sessions - Introduce by @nabokihms in #4561
  • Two-Factor authentication (TOTP) by @nabokihms in #3712
  • feat: add WebAuthn support by @nabokihms in #4704
  • feat: add SSO sharing policy by @nabokihms in #4705
  • feat: Add Kerberos support by @Jabejixo in #4640

Enhancements 🚀

  • fix: clean up in-memory connector before create by @loafoe in #4529
  • feat: Disallow unknown config fields by @nabokihms in #4531
  • feat: saml support refresh tokens by @Jabejixo in #4565
  • feat(gitlab): implement TokenIdentity method by @nabokihms in #4606
  • feat(tests): add MySQL 8 support in CI and tests by @nabokihms in #4617
  • test: add concurrency tests for storage implementations by @nabokihms in #4631
  • feat: update CSS for improved theming and button styles by @nabokihms in #4634
  • feat: add PKCE configuration to OAuth2 settings by @nabokihms in #4638
  • DEP: CEL integration by @nabokihms in #4601
  • feat: add UserIdentity entity and CRUD operations by @nabokihms in #4643
  • feat(logger): add excludeFields config for PII redaction by @mark-liu in #4621
  • Pin GitHub API version in requests by @utafrali in #4647
  • feat: implement user identity creation and persisting consent by @nabokihms in #4645
  • feat: implement AuthSession CRUD operations by @nabokihms in #4646
  • feat(ldap): allow specifying multiple attributes on username input by @yardenshoham in #4061
  • feat: Create AuthSessions and set cookies by @nabokihms in #4650
  • DEP for Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG) / requested_token_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id-jag by @kanywst in #4600

  • feat(server): log successful token exchange requests by @0x2b3bfa0 in #4780
  • ci: improve behavior for first time forks by @cardoe in #4790
  • feat(gitlab): support inherited group claims by @AntonKulyashov in #4800
  • feat: gRPC API for sessions by @nabokihms in #4783
  • GitHub Connector: Implement support for refresh tokens by @matheuscscp in #4845
  • feat: add logout confirmation page by @nabokihms in #4734
  • feat(server): introduce a token issuer abstraction by @nabokihms in #4893

  • feat(server): let a client tie its refresh tokens to the session by @nabokihms in #4950

  • feat(api): add groups field to password requests and responses by @CasLubbers in #4989
  • Configure TLS Curve Preferences and Cipher Suites by @akhilnittala in #4987

Bug Fixes 🐛

  • fix(mysql): quote groups reserved word in query replacer by @backkem in #4580
  • fix(connector): update authproxy and oauth to match CallbackConnector by @matzegebbe in #4589
  • feat(connector): add compile-time checks for connector interfaces by @nabokihms in #4591
  • fix: fix typo in grpc listener error message by @kanywst in #4598
  • fix: correct error message for device request expiry by @kanywst in #4599
  • fix(deviceflow): use absolute paths for non-root URLs by @nabokihms in #4597
  • fix(server): handle double-submit on approval endpoint by @mark-liu in #4620

  • fix: update parseSession callas after merging home page by @nabokihms in #4701
  • fix: migrate Bitbucket Cloud connector to current workspace API by @nicknikolakakis in #4687
  • fix: enforce MFA validation on session login by @jnfrati in #4726
  • fix(refreshhandlers): preserve existing username by @hisamafahri in #4758
  • fix(server): enforce client.AllowedConnectors in handleTokenExchange (GHSA-7qjx-gp9h-65qj) by @matte1782 in #4784
  • fix(gitlab): drop openid scope requirement if there are no groups presented by @space-arens in #4810
  • fix(storage): compare DeviceRequest expiry by instant in conformance test by @arpitjain099 in #4817
  • Update expired OAM test cert by @sagikazarmark in #4864
  • fix(mfa): enforce WebAuthn clone detection, TOTP single-use, and account lockout by @nabokihms in #4884
  • fix(sessions): make SSO sharing non-transitive; drop redirect_uri double-decode by @nabokihms in #4885
  • fix(server): enforce client AllowedConnectors on all token grants by @nabokihms in #4889
  • fix(server): harden several auth-surface security findings by @nabokihms in #4927
  • fix(device): bind device-callback auth code to its request and stop leaking client_secret by @nabokihms in #4928
  • fix(web): keep the connector buttons intact when a connector name is long by @nabokihms in #4939
  • fix(server): return invalid_grant for rejected refresh tokens by @and-win in #5040
  • fix(oidc): keep rootCAs client when providerDiscoveryOverrides is set by @The127 in #5049

entry.title: v2.45.0
entry.content:
Know Before Upgrade

  • The major version of gomplate has been bumped to v5.0.0, which includes breaking changes. Here is the full list.
  • There are two known CVEs in the gomplate binary - CVE-2025-68121 and CVE-2026-25934. gomplate is only used for preprocessing configuration files and is optional. Once the CVEs are fixed upstream, the version of gomplate in the dex image will be updated accordingly.
  • The ContinueOnConnectorFailure feature flag is now enabled by default. To disable it, use the following environment variable: DEX_CONTINUE_ON_CONNECTOR_FAILURE=false.
  • Pre-release versions of dex now use pseudo-versioning for identifying releases. Unreleased versions will follow the pattern v2.minor+1.0-yyyymmdd-commithash.

What's Changed

Exciting New Features 🎉

  • Add support to PKCE in OIDC connector by @johnvan7 in #3777
  • Add Vault signer for JWT by @nabokihms in #4512
